title: Sealing a sender's base key to each call participant
spec: docs/CALLS.md end-to-end encryption, keys. CallKeyPair: an X25519 key pair (generate, from_secret, secret wiped on drop and never in Debug, public_key). seal(recipient public, context, secret): a fresh ephemeral X25519 key; shared = X25519(ephemeral, recipient), refused (BadKey) when all zeros; key = HKDF-SHA256(salt = ephemeral public || recipient public, ikm = shared, info = 'CrewCraft call key seal 1' || context), 32 bytes; AES-256-GCM, zero nonce, context as AAD; box = ephemeral public | ciphertext | tag (OVERHEAD 48 bytes). open(pair, context, box) returns the secret, or Authentication for another recipient, another context or a changed box, Truncated for a short one. The opened key drives SFrame end to end. X25519 from curve25519-dalek (already in the build), HKDF and AES-GCM from ring.
